title: Hoop Stack: Sort Puzzle
seo_title: Hoop Stack Sort Puzzle — Play Free 3D Hoop Sorting Game Online
meta_desc: Play Hoop Stack: Sort Puzzle free online. Stack colorful hoops onto poles in the right order and solve 3D color sorting challenges in your browser.
desc: Hoop Stack: Sort Puzzle asks you to slide colorful hoops onto poles until each pole carries a single color. Every move lifts the top hoop to a matching color or a freer pole, and the neat 3D stacks make each solved board satisfying to look at.
howto: Click or tap a pole to lift its top hoop.
Drop the hoop onto a pole with the same top color or spare room.
Build single-color stacks pole by pole.
Watch for buried hoops that block several colors at once.
Clear every pole to finish the level.
tips: Free the hoop hiding at the bottom of the tallest pole early.
Keep one pole half-empty as your sorting buffer.
Group the color you see most of before touching rare colors.
